messages:
alex_goodman: Quick sync — vendors sent updated launch windows for H100/H200, MI300, and Gaudi. Need to lock embargo windows and comms cadence for marketplace + SI integrations. Who can own comms and the SI handoff?

maya_singh: I can own comms. Need partner-approved PR dates + explicit embargo times from each vendor. Any known vendor blackout days? :calendar:

kevin_choi: FYI from vendor calls: NVIDIA tentative H100 GA week of 2026-05-11, H200 phased ~6 weeks after. AMD MI300 targeting around 2026-06-01. Habana/Gaudi saying mid-June. All provisional, subject to vendor confirmation & firmware soak.

lina_garcia: Ops check — we need ~2 weeks for lab images + cert runs and another week for packaging marketplace artifacts. Recommend earliest marketplace listing cut = 2026-05-25 (if H100 sticks).

alex_goodman: Ok. Maya, propose embargo suggestion: primary announce 2026-06-08 09:00 PT so we can align collateral. That gives ~4 weeks from NVIDIA tentative GA but may be tight for MI300/Gaudi. Thoughts?

maya_singh: Could do staggered: H100/H200 first, MI300/Gaudi follow 1 week later. Stagger reduces risk and gives SI partners breathing room.

kevin_choi: Stagger helps ops, but partners prefer a single joint window when possible. Marketplace teams (AWS/GCP/Azure) need ~10 business days for listings + imagery review. That constraint tilts toward earlier vendor dates.

lina_garcia: Also need runbooks for SI integration: validation checklist, sample infra templates, benchmarking script. I'll own the runbook creation but need SI leads and resource windows.

niya_pm: SI partner list: AccelWorks, CloudOpsPro, SI-Edge — I'll ping them for availability windows. Legal: we need co-marketing approvals and embargo clauses cleared. I'll queue legal review today.

maya_singh: Can someone draft a 1-pager messaging matrix (audience, core message, partner call-to-action)? I can iterate to partner-friendly language.

alex_goodman: I'll start the 1-pager. Quick proposed timeline snippet to align everyone — feel free to edit: 

```
May 11 2026 - NVIDIA H100 tentative GA (vendor)
May 25 2026 - Redwood marketplace artifacts cut / lab images ready
May 26 - Jun 1 2026 - Internal cert + SI smoke tests
Jun 01 2026 - AMD MI300 tentative GA (vendor)
Jun 08 2026 09:00 PT - Public embargoed announcement (H100 primary)
Jun 15 2026 09:00 PT - MI300 / Gaudi follow-up announcement (if staggered)
```

kevin_choi: Two operational asks: (1) list of required image tags & quantization configs for each vendor, (2) fallback/compat policy if a vendor slides. Recommend fallback to compatible CPU/other GPU model and a short note in press materials.

lina_garcia: I'll prepare the test matrix and image-tag table. Can we carve out an SI dry-run week Jun 1–7? That would validate MI300/Gaudi readiness before the public window.

maya_singh: Dry-run week sounds good. Also request: embargo exceptions process (press embargo leaks) — who authorizes early release? suggest senior comms + partner lead signoff.

alex_goodman: Agree. Authorization = senior comms (maya_singh) + partner lead (kevin_choi) + legal signoff (niya_pm).

sam_ops_bot: Reminder: vendor NDAs expiring 2026-05-01 for some partner docs — please confirm extensions if needed.

niya_pm: Noted, I'll check NDA expirations and escalate extensions today.

maya_singh: Action items roundup: 1) Alex — draft 1-pager + press matrix, 2) Lina — test matrix + image tag table + SI runbook, 3) Kevin — chase final vendor GA dates and fallback policy, 4) Niya — legal + SI partner pings, 5) Maya — comms plan + embargo process.

alex_goodman: Thanks. I'll drop the 1-pager in this thread by EOD and tag owners. If vendors confirm earlier dates, we re-evaluate cadence. :thumbsup:
